title: Wicked (Maguire novel) — Survival, Reproduction, Illusion #Shorts
description:
The genes do not care about Wicked (Maguire novel); they care about copies. Wicked: The Life and Times of the Wicked Witch of the West is a 1995 dark fantasy novel by American writer Gregory Maguire, with illustrations by Douglas Smith. It is the first novel in The Wicked Years series, and was followed by Son of a Witch (September 2005), A Lion Among Men (October 2008), and Out of Oz (November 2011), plus a number of short stories since 2012.

Modern psychology keeps rediscovering what the pessimists said first about Wicked (Maguire novel). The novel raises the question of whether evil is inborn or acquired. Elphaba is a social outcast despite being of noble birth, which makes her question how much power she truly has over her own life.
